items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Alice Young. Those three, we were close. I don’t think no other girls were in there at the time.

ctx.x: [cannot recall.] I met her, and she was thrilled with my playing the trombone and all that. We had a good thing going for many years. We played everywhere. We practiced at the Ross Snyder playground. [At night in the summertime they played in the parks.]
Do you remember some of the people besides Minnie and Vi Redd?
Alice Young. Those three, we were close. I don’t think no other girls were in there at the time. And boys . . .
